reason: For sets and decor I need to feel the drape and see the colour under light before I commit to 20 metres, so I go to my local fabric shop first. I'd only look at an online shop like this if my shop ran out, and nothing here tells me it's better than what I already use.
objection: I can't touch it, and when I'm on a deadline for an event I can't risk an item showing out of stock or stuck on pre-order, or a colour that looks different from the photo.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap swatch/sample pack I could feel first, plus live stock numbers I can trust so I know the metres are actually in the warehouse and ship next day.
